what: Long paragraphs such as manifestos or poems, one at a time: when the top edge touches the 100px line from the top of the screen, it rises 1px over 1s expo.out while fading out, and scrolling back reverses it to sharp. Lines already read are cleared from the top in turn, so the text seems to flow over a fixed image.

options.start: ScrollTrigger start line, default top top+=100
options.[data-fx-part=item]: (if present) paragraphs to fade separately — if not, the element itself as one

from.where: index.html .nh-statement__paragraph p — original statement_paragraphText below 1100px: y −1 · opacity 0 · 1s expo.out · start top top+=100 · play none none reverse
